hypothesis: An owned crossing entry need not pay the same fixed opening component as a new entry. Credit only min(1,negotiated) times alpha; preserve all negotiated premiums and native costs.
scope: Only feedback-stage opening objective; unchanged initial plans, candidate legality/diversity/query budgets, branch/source costs, DP/prior same-objective hysteresis and transactions.
qualification: Owned entry credit does not guarantee adoption of a particular retained child; route/STA experiments required. Prefix delay remains separate and deferred because accepted proposed retained candidates were source-measured in both diagnostics.
